subject: Novaresearch: tenant-specific log disposition & SIG/CAIQ evidence request
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <security@novaresearch.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Whitaker <legal@novaresearch.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 15:21:00 -0700
Subject: Request: tenant-level log disposition exceptions + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our SIG review we have a follow-up ask specific to our tenant (Novaresearch) regarding log retention and deletion: we need confirmation and artifacts that demonstrate how Redwood will retain session/interaction logs for up to 180 days for incident investigations, while ensuring all other tenants are subject to the standard 30/90 day TTLs.

Concretely:
- Can you provide a list of artifacts you can deliver that demonstrate this tenant-level exception (config files, routing/tenant mappings, audit log extracts)?
- We also need a sample proof-of-delete workflow for non-exceptioned tenants (manifest + checksums) so our auditors can validate your deletion process.
- Last, please map which SIG/CAIQ sections this evidence satisfies (we're focused on Audit Trail & Monitoring, Data Retention/Deletion, and Access Controls).

Timing: our audit window is tight — ideally we need a package within 7 business days. Is that feasible?

Appreciate the help —
Elena
Security Ops | Novaresearch

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <security@novaresearch.com>
Cc: Tom Whitaker <legal@novaresearch.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: tenant-level log disposition exceptions + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely put together a targeted evidence package for Novaresearch. High-level reply to your asks:

1) Artifacts we can provide for tenant-level exception:
   - Tenant routing policy export (JSON) showing Novaresearch TTL override for session logs (we'll redact internal IPs).
   - Per-tenant retention matrix (PDF) with policy effective dates and owner attestations.
   - Audit trail extract (sample) showing access events and retention flags for Novaresearch tenant.

2) Proof-of-delete for standard tenants:
   - Proof_of_delete_manifest.csv (sample for 30d TTL path) with object IDs + SHA256 checksums.
   - Erasure job runbook (PDF) and S3 lifecycle config snippets.

3) SIG/CAIQ mapping:
   - We'll produce a spreadsheet that maps each artifact to SIG/CAIQ control IDs (Audit Trail, Data Retention, and AC- related items).

Timeline: Ben and I will assemble a staged delivery. We can deliver an initial package in 5 business days and a complete package (with redactions and signatures) in 9 business days. If you need something earlier, we can prioritize the tenant routing export + manifest within 3 business days.

I've looped in Ben (customer security lead) and Marissa (program manager for compliance deliverables) to coordinate the evidence pack.

—
Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <security@novaresearch.com>, Tom Whitaker <legal@novaresearch.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: tenant-level log disposition exceptions + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Kim / team —

Quick update on deliverables and what we'll attach:

Planned attachments (initial drop):
- redwood_novaresearch_evidence_v1.zip (contains: tenant_routing_policy_export.json, per_tenant_retention_matrix.pdf, sample_audit_extract.csv)
- SIG-CAIQ-mapping-20270311.xlsx (control mapping sheet with commentary)
- proof_of_delete_manifest.csv (sample manifest for 30d deletion path)

Notes on redactions and sensitivity:
- The routing export contains internal resource identifiers; we'll sanitize hostnames and remove non-essential tokens.
- Audit extracts will be sampled and will not include full user PII—only event metadata and retention flags.

Proposed delivery schedule:
- Initial package (attachments listed above): EOD Mon, 15 Mar 2027 (5 business days)
- Full signed attestation + extended artifact set (signed by our Compliance lead): Fri, 19 Mar 2027 (9 business days)

If Novaresearch needs the tenant routing export + manifest earlier, say by Thu 12 Mar, we can fast-track those two files — we would need a written non-disclosure acknowledgement from your security team first (standard practice).

I will prepare the artifacts and ship via secure Drive link; Marissa, can you own the packaging and signature collection?

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Customer Security Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ruiz <security@novaresearch.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Whitaker <legal@novaresearch.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: tenant-level log disposition exceptions + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Ben / Kimberly —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the concrete plan. Two small clarifications before you package: 

1) The auditor requested that the proof_of_delete_manifest include the retention-policy-tag field (so we can validate objects were on the 30d path). Can you ensure that column is present in the sample CSV?

2) For the tenant routing export, rather than full JSON we would prefer a concise mapping table (tenant_id, retention_override_days, policy_effective_date, control_owner) — auditors find tabular artifacts easier to ingest. If easier, include both the sanitized JSON and a separate CSV summary.

We can provide the requested NDA acknowledgement by EOD today — we will send the signed email confirmation to the Drive link when available. If you can fast-track the two files by Thu 12 Mar that would be ideal for our audit schedule.

Thanks again —
Elena
